rationale: Generated ui.js carries captured -webkit-font-smoothing: the WidgetBridge gains setFontSmoothing(id, value), wired to Label::set_font_smoothing, and setTextRasterPolicy(policy), stored for the host to read through WidgetBridge::text_raster_policy(); the JS emitter writes them (typeof-guarded) for antialiased text nodes and documents whose design_ir_text_raster_policy is chromium; capture_view and pulp-screenshot pass the policy to the existing render_to_png surface configuration. Bridge manifest, typings, mocks and reference docs regenerated. Pulp-owned paths only; no Vellum-transferred slice, capture or IR format, Chromium, packaging or framework authority moves.
